trust_decision.summary: Untrusted expression text must not be able to make the Interpreter propagate a non-Exception (BaseException subclass such as SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt/GeneratorExit) to the host; the interpreter decides this by catching only `Exception` in run/eval/on_call/Procedure.__call__ while exposing BaseException subclasses in its default symbol table.

landing_point.why: Advisory says 'Sandbox Escape via BaseException Subclasses'; a reader first looks at on_raise, which hands out.__class__ straight to raise_exception, which re-raises it (asteval/asteval.py:264) past `except Exception` in run (asteval/asteval.py:322).

fix_sites.entry_point: Interpreter.eval -> on_call (any call of a symtable callable)
Procedure.__call__ (user def/lambda, callable directly by host code from the symtable)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: asteval/astutils.py:643-755 (Procedure.__call__, a host-callable wrapper whose own `except Exception` at asteval/astutils.py:750 skips symtable/_calldepth restore); also the default-table producer asteval/astutils.py:89-110

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Procedure.__call__ lives in astutils (a 'utilities' file) and is normally reached via on_call, so a solver who hardens run/eval/on_call can argue the inner wrapper is already covered by the outer catch and leave its cleanup path and the FROM_PY table alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Normal user exceptions must still be recorded in aeval.error and caught by in-sandbox try/except (incl. bare except and `raise NameError('bob')`), raise_errors=True must still re-raise the recorded class, and a genuine host-side KeyboardInterrupt (Ctrl-C during a long numpy computation) should not be silently swallowed by a blanket `except BaseException`.

O6_input_shapes: raise of an instance with str args, e.g. SystemExit('x') / KeyboardInterrupt() (on_raise joins out.args, so int-arg instances fail earlier with TypeError at asteval/asteval.py:916)
bare class vs instance (`raise SystemExit` hits out.args descriptor)
alias of the class bound to another name before raising
raise inside def/lambda body (Procedure path asteval/astutils.py:746-755)
raise inside try body (on_try runs body with with_raise=False, asteval/asteval.py:886-887)
BaseException raised by a host/symtable callable (on_call asteval/asteval.py:954-961)

O7_producer.where: asteval/astutils.py:89-110 and asteval/astutils.py:552 (FROM_PY -> BUILTINS_TABLE -> make_symbol_table default symtable exposes BaseException, GeneratorExit, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: with-statement: ctx.__enter__/__exit__ of host objects called with no exception guard; a BaseException in the body skips __exit__ entirely
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: with-blocks are a neighbouring feature; context-manager cleanup looks like a separate bug, not the exception-escape

O8_uncovered_routes.route: import_module wraps __import__ in `except Exception`, so a module raising SystemExit at import escapes when import is enabled
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: import is disabled by default and documented as an explicitly unsafe opt-in

O8_uncovered_routes.route: on_try resolves handler types from the host __builtins__ (not the symtable) and instantiates e_type(); handler matching for BaseException subclasses is decided outside the symtable
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: looks like an unrelated try/except correctness quirk rather than part of the escape

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second narrow `except (...)` tuple in Procedure argument binding that a BaseException can pass through
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the maintainer already writes explicit exception tuples here; widening/narrowing it is natural code

O8b_injection_room.sibling: with-block __exit__ dispatch guarded by `except Exception` only
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: with support is minimal; adding a try/except Exception around the body to call __exit__ is the obvious maintainer change

O8b_injection_room.sibling: SafeFormatter.get_field wrapping obj[i] lookups in `except Exception` for f-string formatting
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: format-field errors are a known pain point (prior f-string advisory) and a catch-Exception wrapper would be idiomatic

O9_family: uncaught exception / sandbox containment failure (CWE-248): BaseException subclasses bypass `except Exception` and exit the host

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change `except Exception` to `except BaseException` in run/eval only (or block SystemExit by name in on_raise), leaving on_call, Procedure.__call__ cleanup and the default FROM_PY table untouched.
